policy.label: Coin Metrics screened-universe portfolios
policy.ranking: Most recent signal-day estimated circulating cap; 30 consecutive positive daily cap observations required
policy.universe: Frozen catalog included=true, less unresolved source-quality instruments listed below. Historical completeness is not established.
policy.missing_signal_cap: Instrument ineligible at that signal; no later information used to fill it
policy.missing_execution_price: Keep that target allocation in USD cash until the next scheduled rebalance; do not replace it with another coin
policy.missing_holding_price: NAV unknown on that date; retain units; defer a rebalance when held units cannot be valued
policy.migration_policy: Retain the per-token study's disclosed migration/parallel-representation exclusions. No synthetic conversions. This is a restricted universe, not all altcoins.
policy.cost_convention: Charge stated bps per dollar bought or sold, including initial purchases; hold final portfolio without a terminal liquidation charge
policy.income: Price only; no staking, airdrops, lending, forks, tax or interest on cash
policy.historical_audit: Public CMC snapshots at each signal compare memberships; source differences are reported, not overwritten or claimed fully resolved
